messages.subject: NA values in fracB
parts:
Dear aroma users/authors,
i am doing now Affy 6.0 SNP data analysis.
I have generated fracB values with aroma package and see now that
there are also NA values present. What could be the reason for this
and with what values could i replace them meaningfully?

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] NA values in fracB
parts:
On Thu, Dec 23, 2010 at 2:08 PM, allab <asph...@googlemail.com> wrote:
> Dear aroma users/authors,
> i am doing now Affy 6.0 SNP data analysis.
> I have generated fracB values with aroma package and see now that
> there are also NA values present. What could be the reason for this
> and with what values could i replace them meaningfully?

The Affymetrix GenomeWideSNP_6 chip type contains ~900,000 SNPs and
~900,000 non-polymorphic loci, cf.

http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6

Allele B fractions (BAFs) are only defined for SNPs. For the
non-polymorphic loci, the BAFs are reported as missing values (NAs).

/Henrik
